pages.title: Getting it back out
pages.text: Hold right click on a $(thing)cauldron$() with the detector to drain it. It removes $(thing)one ore at a time, smallest charge first$(), so a stray 10 mB in the way clears in a short pull without costing the charges you wanted.

pages.title: Nullified Bucket
pages.text: Draining $(thing)forgets$() which ore the liquid was, which is why one fluid covers every mix.$(br2)The cauldron holds a bucket's worth and fills in quarters, but it counts what you actually put in: a small charge costs a small amount rather than a whole quarter. The bucket empties into water or lava only.
